messages:
lia_cs: Quick sync for Alpha preview cohort starting Mon. Need owners for invites, day-3 + day-14 feedback, and initial risk signals.

owen_se: I can send invites. Which template?

lia_cs: Use 'Preview Kickstart v1' (includes troubleshooting checklist). I'll paste the short FAQ for the invite body.

tara_p: I built a concise day3 + day14 pulse (2 scale q's + 1 comment). Form: https://forms.gle/alphaPulseEX. Automation triggers after first successful call and again day14.

owen_se: I'll attach the enablement slide and run the calendar event at 9am PT.

lia_cs: Risk signal proposal: flag if <40 calls OR <$20 spend in first 14 days, or if enablement no-show + no follow up in 72h. Tag `preview-risk`.

tara_p: Agree. Day14 routed to PRODBETA-456 in Jira. Day3 stays with CS queue.

infra-bot: Note: telemetry alert 'alpha-latency' created for 95p >1s in 72h, posting to #eng-runtime.

lia_cs: Owners: owen = invites; tara = pulse + routing; I'll handle outreach for flagged accounts. Please confirm by EOD.

owen_se: Confirmed. Invite scheduled.

lia_cs: Thanks team — will update cohort doc and share a short recap after kickoff.
